candidate_rare_color_bounding_box.definition: Unique most-frequent background; unique least-frequent non-background color; crop bounding rectangle of its cells; reject ties, empty and unchanged crop; require at least two distinct inputs and exact fit to all training outputs.

candidate_9_anchor_crop_color_map.definition: Common training output shape; enumerate nine relative crop anchors and deterministic color maps; require all training pairs fit, candidate predictions agree, no unknown test colors, and no leave-one-train conflict.

limitations: These are narrow safe subsets of historical functions, not a full replay of the old solver.
The new cohort was selected after prior development, so earlier exposure and benchmark independence remain unproven.
No same-condition pass@2 improvement or official score is established.
